它解决什么问题 Qoder CN 桌面 App 自带一批模型（Qwen、DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax 等 14 个），订阅后即可调用。但这些模型**只能在 Qoder 自己的客户端里用** —— 想在 DSH 里把它们当成一个 provider 来跑 agent，官方没有提供任何入口。 这个插件做的就是这件事： ``` Qoder CN 桌面 App 已经登录的账号 │ │ ① 读本地 auth.v1.dat（DPAPI + AES-256-GCM 解密） ▼ 凭据存储 ──→ 自动续期（drt- → dt-），删掉 App 也能继续跑 │ │ ② WASM 签名 + WAF 编码 ▼ Qoder 网关 ──→ 14 个模型，注册成 DSH 的 `qoder` provider │ │ ③ 反向翻译成 OpenAI Chat Completions ▼ DSH 对话 / agent / 工具调用 ``` **核心卖点：零配置。** 不用去开发者后台申请 Key，不用复制粘贴 Token，不用处理过期。只要你的 Qoder CN 桌面 App 登录着，插件就能自己找到凭据、自己续期、自己拉模型列表。 --- ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | |---|---| | 🔑 **凭据自动发现** | 直接解密 Qoder CN 桌面 App 的 `auth.v1.dat`，双源备份 + 自动续期，**删掉 App 也能继续用** | | 🧠 **14 个模型** | 实时拉取官方模型目录，拉不到时用内置兜底 | | 📏 **1M 上下文档位** | 官方目录里 `200K/400K/1M` 三档，默认给最大档（竞品普遍锁在 180K） | | 🔢 **回合身份** | 重建 `business.id` / `stage`，让 Qoder 的积分面板按回合正确聚合 | | 🔍 **联网搜索** | 接成 DSH 的 web 搜索 provider，走 Qoder 自己的搜索端点 | | 🖼️ **图片上传** | 内联 base64 自动传到 Qoder 图床换 OSS URL，失败自动回退 | | 🎚️ **推理档位探测** | 实测每个模型真正接受哪些 effort（目录里写的经常是假的） | | 💰 **额度 / 签到** | 剩余积分、订阅套餐、每日奖励自动领取 | | 🖥️ **图形界面** | DSH 插件详情页六个 tab：账号 / 额度 / 模型 / 档位 / 搜索 / 图片 | | ⌨️ **命令行** | `status` `doctor` `models` `ask` `refresh` `logout` `credits` `checkin` `search` `upload` | --- ## 环境要求 - **Windows**（凭据解密依赖 Windows DPAPI） - **Qoder CN 桌面 App** 已安装且**至少登录过一次**（之后删掉也行，见下） - **DeepSeek Harness** 已安装 - Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` > 只支持 **Qoder CN**（`qoder.com.cn`）。国际版 Qoder（`qoder.sh`）域名与协议不同，未做适配。 --- ## 安装 ### 方式一：作为 profile bundle（推荐） ```bash git clone https://github.com/YSwo-fei/dsh-qoder-connect.git ``` 然后把插件挂到你的 DSH profile 上。编辑 `/profiles//package.json`： ```jsonc { "dependencies": { "dsh-qoder-connect": "file:/绝对路径/dsh-qoder-connect" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // …其它 bundle… "dsh-qoder-connect" ] } } } ``` 然后在 profile 目录里 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。 ### 方式二：直接放进插件目录 把仓库整个复制到 `/.dsh/plugins/dsh-qoder-connect`，再按上面的方式在 profile 里引用。 --- ## 快速开始 装好重启 DSH 后，打开 **设置 → 插件 → DSH Qoder CN Connect**，应该能看到账号已登录、模型列表已加载。 命令行自检： ```bash # 四项全绿才算健康 dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-qoder-connect doctor # 看看有哪些模型 dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-qoder-connect models # 直接问一句 dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-qoder-connect ask qfmodel "你好" ``` 在 DSH 里选模型时，provider 选 `qoder`，就能看到 14 个模型。 --- ## 命令行 ```bash dsh-qoder-connect status # 凭据 / 模型 / 额度 总览 dsh-qoder-connect doctor [--json] # 逐项体检：凭据 / 目录 / 对话 / shim dsh-qoder-connect models [--json] # 模型目录 dsh-qoder-connect ask <模型> <内容> # 直接打一次推理 dsh-qoder-connect refresh # 立即续期一次 dsh-qoder-connect logout # 删除自留凭据副本（不动桌面 App 的登录） dsh-qoder-connect credits [--json] # 额度 + 套餐 + 活动列表 dsh-qoder-connect checkin # 立即签到 dsh-qoder-connect search "查询内容" # 联网搜索 dsh-qoder-connect upload ./图片.png # 上传图片到图床 ``` --- ## 凭据是怎么来的 这是本插件**不依赖 Qoder CN 桌面 App** 的关键。 | 来源 | 位置 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 桌面副本 | `%APPDATA%\com.qodercn.app.stable\auth.v1.dat` | Qoder CN 自己维护，DPAPI + AES-256-GCM 加密 | | 自留副本 | `/.qoder-auth.json` | 插件自己维护，明文 JSON，权限 0600 | `lib/authstore.js` 的 `QoderCredentialStore`： 1. **双源择一** —— 两份都在时，`uid` 不一致以桌面为准（说明用户重新登录过），否则取到期更晚的一份。 2. **启动即镜像** —— 只要读到桌面副本就顺手写一份自留副本（不必等到快过期）。 3. **自动续期** —— 距到期不足 5 分钟时自己续： ``` POST https://openapi.qoder.com.cn/api/v1/deviceToken/refresh {"refresh_token":"drt-…"} → {"device_token":"dt-…","refresh_token":"drt-…","expires_at":"…"} ``` 续期成功后写回自留副本（临时文件 + 原子改名）。`resolve()` 是 single-flight 的，并发请求只发一次。 4. **续期失败不立刻死** —— 若还没真过期（留 30 秒余量），先用旧凭据继续跑，只记一条 warn。 > **不会把桌面 App 踢下线。** 服务端每次续期都轮换 `refresh_token`，但**旧值不会立刻失效**（实测用已被轮换掉的旧 `drt-` 再打一次仍返回 200）。插件和 App 各自持有可用的 `drt-`，互不影响。 **所以删掉 Qoder CN 桌面 App 之后，插件照常工作。** 唯一失效的情形是自留副本的 `refresh_token_expires_at` 也过了（约一年），那时需要重新登录一次桌面 App。 --- ## 额度 / 订阅 / 自动签到 `lib/account.js` 走 Qoder 的 openapi： | 方法 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `GET` | `/sash/api/v2/me/usage` | 额度用量（加购额度 + 套餐额度） | | `GET` | `/api/v2/user/plan` | 订阅套餐与功能开关 | | `GET` | `/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns` | 活动列表（含签到状态） | | `POST` | `/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns//claim` | 领取奖励（**幂等**） | | `GET` | `/sash/api/v1/ai-conversations/credits-summary` | 历史累计用量 | ### 自动签到 Qoder 的每日奖励是「活动」形式：**每天 10:00（UTC+8）刷新，每次 100 Credits，领取后 30 天有效**。 1. 只对 `actionType === "CLAIM_BENEFIT"` 且 `claimStatus === "CLAIMABLE"` 的活动发 `POST /claim`； 2. **服务端幂等** —— 重复领取返回 `replayed: true`，不会重复到账，所以重试安全； 3. 结果落盘 `/.qoder-account.json`； 4. **只对「上次成功」设 1 小时冷却** —— 上次失败要立刻重试，别让一次网络抖动赔上一小时。 默认 30 分钟轮询一次，启动时立即跑一次。关掉：`autoCheckIn: false`。 --- ## 配置项 在 DSH 的插件配置里可以改（也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `uid` / `token` | 自动 | 手动指定凭据（一般不用填） | | `appDataDir` | 自动 | Qoder CN 的 AppData 目录 | | `refreshIntervalMs` | — | 凭据续期轮询间隔 | | `accountIntervalMs` | 30 分钟 | 额度/签到轮询间隔 | | `autoCheckIn` | `true` | 自动领取每日奖励 | | `hideModels` | `[]` | 不想在 DSH 里出现的模型 | | `contextTier` | `{}` | 逐模型指定上下文档位，如 `{"qfmodel": 1000000}` | | `webSearch` | `true` | 把 Qoder 搜索注册成 DSH 的 web provider | | `imageUpload` | `true` | 内联图片自动传图床 | --- ## 技术细节
推理端点与签名 ``` POST https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v2/service/pro/sse/agent_chat_generation ?FetchKeys=llm_model_result&AgentId=agent_common&Encode=1 ``` 请求体是加密 + WAF 编码后的 SSE 请求。签名由 WASM 的 `prepareInferRequest` 生成： - RSA-PKCS1 加密随机 AES Key - AES-128-CBC 加密用户信息 - `Authorization: COSY.<468字符base64>.<32字符md5>` - md5 签名串 = `payloadB64 + "\n" + cosyKey + "\n" + ts + "\n" + body + "\n" + sigPath` `Encode=1` 的端点必须用 WAF 编码（`lib/cosy.js` 的 `qoderEncodeBody()`）：base64 → 按 `floor(n/3)` 旋转 → 自定义字母表替换。**已实测与 WASM 输出逐字节一致。**
联网搜索 ``` POST https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v1/webSearch/oneSearch?Encode=1 ``` body 两层套：内层 `{query, timeRange:"NoLimit", contents:{…}}` 的 JSON **字符串**，外层再包成 `{payload: <内层>, encodeVersion:"1"}`，整体过 WAF 编码。签名签的是**编码后**的串。 踩过的坑： - 带 `Encode=1` 却发明文 body → **HTTP 500**；不带 `Encode` → **HTTP 400**。 - `contents` 全开时响应多出 `mainText`/`markdownText`/`summary`，但耗时从 ~0.45s 涨到 **8.5s** → 默认全关。 - **HTTP 200 里也可能是业务错误**：query 超长返回 `{errorCode:400,…}`。必须查 `errorCode`。上限 1000 字符。 **为什么要改 `web` 行的 `searchProvider`：** 基础层写死 `deepseek-official`，而缝**先解析「已配置的 id」**，配置了却不可用会直接抛 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`，**不回退**。DeepSeek 那个 provider 的 `available()` 判据里 `resolveApiKey`/`resolveAccountToken` 恒为函数，所以**没配 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 它也报 available**，缝永远不会选到 Qoder。本插件的 bundle patch 覆盖了 `web` 行，profile 层优先级更高，想换回去只改 profile 即可。
图片上传 ``` PUT https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v2/image/upload?request_id=<32位无横线uuid> Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----qodercli-<32位无横线uuid> ``` - CN 的 `center` 与推理网关**同域**（`gateway.qoder.com.cn`）。 - 相对路径用官方的 `/api/v2/image/upload`（**不带 `/a

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) for Visual Studio: review every file edit the agent proposes in Visual Studio's native diff window before it touches disk. Read-only IDE tools over MCP. Community-built, unofficial. | 在 Visual Studio 原生 diff 里审阅 agent 的每处文件改动，接受才落盘。社区作品，非官方。
plugins.readme_text:
English | [中文](README.zh.md)

# DeepSeek Harness for Visual Studio

Bring **DeepSeek Harness** (dsh) into Visual Studio:

- **Native diff gate.** When the agent wants to change a file, the diff opens in Visual
  Studio's own comparison window — left is what is on disk, right is what the model
  proposes — with Accept and Reject. Nothing is written until you accept, and a rejection
  can carry an explanation that goes straight back to the model.
- **Visual Studio tools for the agent.** The session gets read-only MCP tools that report
  IDE state: which solution is open, which files are in the editor, what you have selected.
  The model stops guessing about your workspace.

Setup is the VSIX plus one command. Nothing is copied into your repository, nothing is added
to your DeepSeek Harness profile, and uninstalling leaves only a folder under
`%LOCALAPPDATA%` for you to delete if you want it gone.

> **Unofficial.** This is a community-built integration. It is not affiliated with, endorsed
> by, or supported by DeepSeek. DeepSeek Harness is their product; this repository only adds
> an IDE surface to it.

**Looking for VS Code?** This is for **Visual Studio** (the IDE). There are separate
community extensions for VS Code.
## Status

Early, but every claim below has been checked somewhere specific, and the table says where.

| Piece | State |
| --- | --- |
| Diff gate, edit on an existing file | **Verified in Visual Studio.** Reject left the file untouched and the reason reached the model; Accept wrote it |
| Diff gate, write of a new file | **Verified in Visual Studio.** Reject created nothing — no file, not even a zero-byte placeholder |
| Reads are not gated | **Verified.** A read passes through without a diff |
| MCP endpoint | Verified with the MCP client library the harness itself uses |
| `get_environment`, `get_open_files` | Verified in a live agent session |
| `get_current_selection` | Verified in a live session: with a selection, and with a bare caret |
| Starting a session from Visual Studio | **Works.** Tools — DeepSeek Harness — Start session |
| Status command | Works |
| `str_replace_editor` (create, insert, str_replace, view) | **Verified** against a session with the tool mounted. `create`, `str_replace` and `insert` each sent the correct before/after content; `view` did not reach the bridge at all, which is the read exemption working |

The tool surface the agent gets:

| Tool | Reads | Writes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mcp__vs__get_environment` | solution path, workspace folder, process id | nothing |
| `mcp__vs__get_open_files` | the files in the editor, with the active one marked | nothing |
| `mcp__vs__get_current_selection` | the selected text, its file and line range | nothing |

All three are read-only. The gate is the only thing that can affect a file, and it affects
nothing by itself — it shows a diff and returns your verdict.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for what the bridge exposes and what it does not.
## Requirements

- Visual Studio 2022 17.14 or newer (developed against Visual Studio 2026 18.10)
- .NET Framework 4.8
- DeepSeek Harness: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- The TUI launcher: `npm install -g @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`

## Install

```powershell
& "$env:ProgramFiles\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\IDE\VSIXInstaller.exe" `
  .\artifacts\DeepSeekHarness.VisualStudio.vsix
```

Adjust the path for your edition. Restart Visual Studio afterwards.

## Use

Open a solution, then:

> **Tools — DeepSeek Harness — Start session**

A terminal tab opens running DeepSeek Harness with the gate attached. In that session the
agent can call the Visual Studio tools as `mcp__vs__*`, and every file edit it proposes opens
in Visual Studio's diff window first.

To run a session somewhere else, attach the same patch by hand:

```powershell
dsh-tui --patch "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\DeepSeekHarness\vs-bridge\dsh-patch.yml"
```

The patch is rewritten every time Visual Studio starts, because it carries the bridge's
current port and token. The command stays the same.

### The menu

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Start session** | Opens a terminal tab running a gated session |
| **Status...** | Reports whether the gate is armed, and what is missing when it is not |
| **Open log** | Opens `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\vs-extension.log` |
| **Clean up installed files...** | Deletes the folder this extension writes to. **Optional** - see below |

**About Clean up installed files:** you do not need it to stop using the extension.
Uninstalling it from *Extensions -> Manage Extensions* already removes every capability: with
no Visual Studio there is no bridge, sessions run ungated, and nothing on disk starts by
itself. What remains is a plugin file, a launch script and a log - inert files in
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\`.

A VSIX uninstall cannot run code, so it cannot remove that folder for you. This command is
the only way to delete it, and it is there for people who want the folder gone, not as a
required step. It asks for confirmation and names the folder first.
## How it works

```
agent wants to write a file
  -> the gate plugin intercepts the call at tools/pre-execute
  -> it reads the file and works out the exact bytes the tool would write
  -> it posts both to the extension's loopback endpoint
  -> the extension opens Visual Studio's native diff
  -> you accept or reject
  -> the verdict becomes the call's pre-execute decision
  -> accepted writes land; a rejection fails the call with your reason attached
```

The agent reaches Visual Studio state over MCP: the extension serves `/mcp` on the same
loopback endpoint and registers itself with `dsh-mcp-client`.

### The gate is a plugin this repository owns

`packages/dsh-plugin-vs-gate` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin. The extension embeds it in the
VSIX, writes it under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\dsh-plugin`, and mounts it from the
generated patch.

It speaks the harness's own `tools/pre-execute` contract rather than Claude Code's
`hookSpecificOutput` format. An earlier version borrowed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code`
and drove it from a PowerShell script; the reasons that was replaced are worth recording,
because two of them were bugs that took a long time to see:

**1. A package directory cannot be imported.** The patch named the borrowed package by a URL
ending in the package name. Node answers `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT` for that — only bare
specifiers get package resolution — and the harness reports the failure as one line,
`entry did not activate`, then carries on. The gate was simply absent while the MCP entry in
the same patch kept working, so every part of the integration looked healthy. If a mount
fails, say so loudly; a component that fails open and silently is worse than one that fails.

**2. Out of process means guessing.** The script only saw the tool's arguments, so it had to
reconstruct the result. That produced two defects that each showed the reviewer a diff
with no changes in it, which is worse than no diff: a name clash where `str_replace_editor`'s
`create` and `insert` commands carry no `old_str`, and a CRLF conversion that inserted a
carriage return into an already-CRLF search string. A plugin runs in-process and reads the
file, so the proposal is built from the same bytes the tool will write.

**3. Failure must not look like success.** The script failed open: a missing bridge meant
every edit landed unreviewed. The plugin answers `ask` instead, handing the call to the
harness's own permission flow. "I cannot show you this change" is not the same as "this
change is fine".

### The plugin can also be installed on its own

`packages/dsh-plugin-vs-gate` declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so it installs with
DeepSeek Harness's own command:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:VSworder/deepseek-harness-visual-studio#packages/dsh-plugin-vs-gate
```

That is for running DeepSeek Harness in your own terminal rather than through **Start
session**, and it gets the same thing: the diff gate, and the three Visual Studio tools.
The plugin mounts the MCP client itself once it finds a bridge, so every route ends up with
the same set. The

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chrome-operation

A DSH plugin that turns your local Chrome browser into a set of DSH tools. It pairs with the **chrome operation** (chrome-operation) MV3 Chrome extension, which runs a WebSocket bridge inside your browser. The DSH plugin dials that bridge over loopback and exposes browser actions as DSH tools, so DSH agents can drive a real local Chrome browser.

## How it works

1. The **chrome-operation** extension (MV3) runs a background service worker that listens on
   `ws://127.0.0.1:18765/ext/bridge` (with a 15-second keep-alive ping so the Chrome service worker doesn't go idle and drop the connection).
2. The **dsh-chrome-operation** DSH plugin starts, connects to that WS bridge, and registers the `browser_*` tools.
3. When DSH calls a `browser_*` tool, the request flows over the bridge and the extension performs the action in a real Chrome tab.

## Installation

### 1. Load the Chrome extension
1. Open `chrome://extensions`.
2. Enable **Developer mode** (top-right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the `chrome-operation` extension directory.
4. A token is written to `chrome.storage.local.token` (managed by the extension / `issue-token` dev script).

### 2. Install the DSH plugin
The plugin is distributed on npm as `dsh-chrome-operation`.

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-chrome-operation
```

### 3. Restart DSH
The plugin activates on a profile restart. Restart DSH desktop, then confirm the connection (the plugin logs `bridge ready` / `extension connected`).

## Tools exposed
`browser_snapshot`, `browser_get_text`, `browser_navigate`, `browser_open_tab`, `browser_list_tabs`, `browser_close_tab`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, `browser_press`, `browser_scroll`, `browser_wait`, `browser_back`, `browser_forward`, `browser_reload`.

## Configuration
- The bridge listens on loopback only (`127.0.0.1`) — local use only.
- The extension reads the `token` from `chrome.storage.local`.
- The default WS `pingIntervalMs` is `15000` (configurable via the bridge config endpoint `/ext/bridge-config`). Chrome's service worker goes idle ~30s; the 15s ping keeps it awake.

## Notes
- Requires **Chrome** (the extension is MV3 and uses a service worker).
- On complex pages `browser_snapshot` may return empty; prefer `browser_get_text` + navigation for reading content.
- If DSH ever complains about the `dshWorkshop` block, delete that top-level key — the plugin still loads via `cordis.patch.yml`.

plugins.readme_text:
# 自动开发调度器（dsh-orchestrator 系列）

> DSH agent preset 插件：单会话双态——先以调度员身份与你交互完成产品设计（并行研究员调研 → 方案 → 决策清点 → 定稿），一句确认后切换为调度引擎，goal 驱动自动推进开发流水线（审核员计划审核 → 开发员执行自测 → 审核员 AC 证据核验+代码审查 → 调度员构建），推进到「待人工测试」硬停止等你实测；验收阶段走修复循环（T0~T3 证据链）。
>
> **当前版本：v2.10.1**（2026-10-13 发布）　|　**相对上版 v2.10.0 的差异**：codegraph 闭环强制同步——**每次任务完结必须更新代码图谱**成硬规则：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员在项目根机械执行 `codegraph sync`，无条件、不分内外层、改了什么就更新什么；未同步不得关闭，验收结论.md 增「codegraph 同步」记录行，关卡3 收尾兜底再同步一次（用户指令 2026-10-13）；规范升 v2.1.6（§六 新增第 7 条闭环门禁 + §六 第 4/6 条与 §2.4 挂引用，经生成器 CG-A~F 六个 op 落地、--check 逐字节校验）；persona 四处同源（A1 连跑前置 sync／新增闭环段／P2-1 修复包前置／收尾门禁 ⓪ 步）＋验收结论模板同步；原子升版（五处版本载体 + pkg-consistency 常量族同候选 commit 切换）。套件 561→561/0（断言数不变）；机器层零改动（dispatch/phase-gate/budget 零改动，不新增状态/环节/角色）。
> **宿主要求**：建议 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 起（0.1.7 声明式预设机制：包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 自动生成预设声明层，无需手工处理）；v2.10.1 实测于 DSH web 版与桌面版（Electron，desktop profile）　|　规范：项目目录及协同开发规范 **v2.1**（六区结构，本文档 v2.1.6）

## 版本与能力速览（v2.10.1）

- **codegraph 闭环强制同步（v2.10.1 新增）**：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员机械执行 `codegraph sync`（不分内外层、改了什么更新什么）；未同步不得关闭，验收结论留同步记录行；收尾兜底再同步；codegraph 不可用按降级口径如实标注，不伪造——图谱始终是最新单一事实源
- **模板目录归集（v2.10.0）**：脚手架四区「按任务复制用」模板 21 件收进各区 `_模板/` 子文件夹，区根不再平铺混杂；三级复制源回退（项目内 `_模板/` → 旧平铺位 → 预设包 spec/templates）老项目无损；规范 v2.1.5
- **三阶段工作流**：交互态设计（grill-me 决策清点开场问档）→ goal 驱动单包开发（一次授权多包连跑，五态流水线）→ 验收修复循环（含审核员修复审查）
- **两类任务场景**：新产品全流程 / 修改已有系统（场景1：现状研究中+目标代码区约束）；另有**技术调研储备**（场景2，独立终态不进开发）
- **首次使用引导与开工门禁（v2.9.0 新增）**：新会话首次对话先探查后告知（插件级 3 项＋项目级 6 项，只列缺失/未验证项，零副作用）；按需授权逐项补齐；`enter_auto_mode` 开发准备门禁 fail-closed（`00-项目管理/开发准备.md` 记录不齐即拒并列缺项）；远程仓库/测试服务器允许「不适用」须写理由，codegraph 不自动降级
- **对话形态纪律（v2.8.0 新增）**：全部人读消息 answer-first + 结尾唯一下一步 + 首尾双问自检 + 分组 ≤5（证据优先于简洁）；提问纪律（一次一决策点/选项 ≤4 推荐置顶/优先卡片提问）；过程消息一行制；不采用项成文（状态.md 唯一真源不散文重述／不删限定词／证据·债务清单不设条数上限／输出更短非目标）
- **子代理模型路由与会话覆盖（v2.7.0 新增）**：每角色默认+降级双槽路由（持久配置现读、原子写、不落在预设同步树）；429/额度类错误自动切降级（G1 硬闸门：插件独占先于宿主重试，不消耗默认模型重试预算；降级失败即停不循环；非适用错误不误降级）；会话临时改模（缺省仅当次主会话、epoch 隔离、在跑 child 快照不受影响、压缩不丢）与显式永久改默认/降级（原子保存、新派工即生效）；「仅下一次」一次性语义明确拒绝不落状态
- **挂载防回归（v2.7.1）**：delegation 组本地模块行必须导出 `apply` 的装配断言（config-check T3h，含缺 apply 夹具检红演算）；注册与更新前体检**双 profile 覆盖**（web 走 CLI、desktop 走 Electron 管理）
- **SpecKit 证据裁决口径（v2.6.1 起）**：AC 证据核验表「证据等级/逐项状态」列；修复包未决澄清闸门、根因初判、正当扩围第三态、上游指针；场景2 裁决三态、反证强制与 `ASSUMPTION` 标记
- **运行安全三层机制（v2.4.x）**：派工生成**三问裁定**；开发员**五条刹车纪律 + 心跳**；**看门狗**（B/C 后台派工、调度员轮内 tick 值班，L0 观察→L1 steer→L2 中断→L3 停机）；恢复轮孤儿接管；审核员计划审核第 5 项判断题
- **调度可靠性机器层**：预算台账 = 环节级 WAL/结算账本（schema v2 身份行 + runId/attempt/派工前阶段/结算后阶段/candidateCommit/evidencePath 六列）、runId 精确结算、派工返回六态（DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED/FAILED/INTERRUPTED）、dispatch_status 四方一致检查+续跑建议、旧台账 v1→v2 迁移、故障注入五项回归套件
- **质量闸门**：任务包改动点「消费/产出」接口契约 + 计划审核跨改动点冲突扫描；验收「无证或不可证伪即驳回」；修复包 T0 根因→T1 RED→T2 GREEN→T3 回归证据链；代码审查 loadBearing 承重标注；P1-8 审核纪律（不机械重跑/选择性复验/证据缺失驳回）
- **预算纪律**：按包分档三硬上限（小包 4/6/24、大包 8/8/48，派工即计次），token 纯统计、无费用概念
- **与 1.0（orchestrator）并存不替代**：两插件各自独立，按会话独占加载

## 安装

本仓库为**发布镜像**（只含最新版本）。安装包：`05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1/`（或同名 zip 解压到本地目录后按目录安装）。

**web 版（`dsh web`，profile=web，CLI 一条命令）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/路径/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1
```

**桌面版（Electron，profile=desktop，由应用专属管理，CLI 写入会被拒 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`）：**

1. 打开桌面版**插件管理**界面（设置 → 插件），添加/更新插件，方式选「本地目录（link）」，指向 `…/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1` 包目录；
2. 若界面不可用或需脚本化，可用**手工三件套**（操作前备份原文件）：① 改 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 link 依赖行指向新包目录；② 同步 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 对应两行；③ 把 `node_modules/dsh-orchestrator2` junction 重指到新包目录。

**两端通用**：装完**完全退出并重启**（桌面版注意先退出托盘进程，避免旧实例占端口）；新建会话在预设选择器选「自动开发调度器2.0」。重启前建议体检：`node "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" web --dump-config`——① 组合树含 `preset-orchestrator2`；② 零死引用；③ 注册指向新包。详见包根 `测试入口说明.md` 与包内 `presets/orchestrator2/docs/使用手册.md`。

> 注：0.1.7 起预设走声明式机制（包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 在宿主启动时自动把预设声明进组合树）；旧版「裸目录拷贝到 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets`」方式已随 0.1.7 移除，勿再用。

plugins.description: One-click restart for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: a sidebar-footer button plus a detached supervisor that relaunches the whole app, so a rebuilt plugin or profile change takes effect immediately.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-restart · 一键重启 DSH

[![CI](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-plugin-restart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-plugin-restart/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

插件迭代后，**点一下界面上的「重启 DSH」按钮**，整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用（Electron 外壳 + Host）会退出并自动重新启动，让刚重建的插件包、组合（bundle）、preset 立即生效。

- **左下角头像/设置那一排**的图标按钮（`sidebar.footer.action`，`order: 10`）：纯图标、无文字，悬停有提示，点击后在**侧栏内**（不是窗口角落）弹出确认面板——一句标题 `重启 DSH`、一条弱化的范围备注 `（应用与 Host）`，加 取消 / 立即重启。
- 可选：`tray/tray-host.ps1` 提供 Windows 托盘入口「重启 DSH」，不依赖界面也能重启/拉起。

本包**不修改 DSH 源码、不需要 fork**：它是一个标准 profile bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`），装进当前 profile 即可。

## 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows 10 / 11 | 守护脚本用 `Get-Process` / `Start-Process` / `taskkill` / WMI `Win32_Process.Create`，均为 Windows 专有 |
| Shell | **Windows PowerShell 5.1**（`powershell.exe`） | `lib/restart-supervisor.ps1` 声明 `#requires -Version 5.1`；Host 默认就以 `powershell.exe` 启动守护脚本（可用 `DSH_POWERSHELL` 覆盖）。**未适配 pwsh 7** |
| Node | ≥ 20（仅用于自检脚本） | 插件本体在 DSH 内运行，不需要额外的 Node 运行时 |
| DSH | 桌面版（Electron 外壳） | 一键重启的对象是「应用 + Host」，纯 Web/CLI 形态没有可重启的外壳 |

`package.json` 里声明了 `"os": ["win32"]`，在其它平台上安装会被包管理器直接拒绝。

## 为什么必须这么做（进程模型约束）

| 事实 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| 桌面端 Host 是 Electron 主进程的子进程，主进程把 Host 的退出一律当作崩溃（`dsh desktop host stopped`），并弹出原生对话框「DeepSeek Harness 无法使用」+ Windows 系统提示音 | 「只重启 Host」必然弹框；**杀进程的顺序也必须先杀 Electron 主进程**（见第 6 节），否则每次一键重启都会闪一个对话框 |
| 官方菜单里的「重启应用与 Host」被编译在 `development` 开关后面（正式版构建不暴露） | 界面/菜单没有可用重启入口 |
| Host 进程无法让父进程 `app.relaunch()`，也无法在自身被拆掉后继续干活 | 需要**脱离进程的守护者** |

### Windows 上「脱离进程」的实测结论（都踩过坑，改动前先读）

1. **`spawn(exe, args, { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' })` 不足以让子进程在父进程退出后存活。**
   实测：父进程退出后，detached 子进程的标记文件**从未生成**；同样内容经 `cmd /c start` 启动则生成。早期版本的守护脚本因此「杀掉了旧应用，却没能启动新应用」——日志停在 `processes after stop = 0` 之后。
2. **`cmd /c start` 一旦 stdout 被捕获就会永久阻塞。** 实测：裸调用 35ms 返回；`| Out-Null` 或 `| ForEach-Object` 下无限挂起（`start` 不退出，管道等不到 EOF）。
3. 因此守护进程改用 **WMI 创建**（`Win32_Process.Create`）：由 WMI 服务在**本进程树与句柄继承之外**创建，调用立即返回。实现见 `index.js` 的 `spawnSupervisor`（命令行经 base64 临时文件传递，避免 `-Command` 吞引号）。
4. **拉起 GUI 应用用 `Start-Process`，并且要等窗口，而不是只等进程。**
   实测：在隐藏控制台里启动应用，进程起来了但**没有可见窗口**——用户看到的就是「客户端没被拉起」。守护脚本现在轮询 `MainWindowHandle`：拿到窗口才算 `phase: relaunched`；20 秒内没窗口则记为 `relaunched-no-window`（诚实反映异常，而不是谎报成功）。

守护脚本（`lib/restart-supervisor.ps1`）的顺序：等待触发 → **先校验 exe 存在**（绝不关闭一个无法重新启动的应用）→ 列出将要终止的进程 → **先单独终止应用根进程（Electron 主进程）并确认它已消失** → 再按镜像名 `taskkill /F` 处理其余进程 → 有界等待到全部消失 → 启动**恰好一个**实例 → 等窗口 → 写 `restart-result.json`（无 BOM，Node 的 `JSON.parse` 才能读）。

> 关于「等待」：HTTP 应答与守护脚本启动之间的延迟 `armDelayMs` 由 **Host 侧** `setTimeout` 完成（`index.js` 的 `apply()`），不通过命令行传给守护脚本——守护脚本多等一秒就会被用户感知成「点了没反应」。`spawnSupervisor` 只传 `-Exe / -GraceMs / -StateDir / -LogPath / -ResultPath`。

### 5. 守护进程的控制台窗口必须在创建时就隐藏

WMI 创建的进程会**分配一个新的控制台**。命令行里的 `-WindowStyle Hidden` 是 PowerShell 启动**之后**才生效的，所以窗口会先以可见状态创建、再被隐藏——用户看到的就是每次重启动一下的命令行窗口。做法是给 `Win32_Process.Create` 传一个 `Win32_ProcessStartup` 并把 `ShowWindow` 设为 `0`（SW_HIDE），让控制台**创建时就是隐藏的**。

实测边界（Windows 11 + PowerShell 5.1）：

| 做法 | 控制台可见 | 进程是否正常执行 |
|---|---|---|
| 不传 startup info | **可见** | 是 |
| 命令行 `-WindowStyle Hidden` | 隐藏（但创建瞬间会闪） | 是 |
| **`ShowWindow = 0`** | **隐藏，且无闪窗** | 是 |
| `ShowWindow = 0` + `CreateFlags = 1` | — | **否：进程起来了但从不执行载荷** |
| `ShowWindow = 0` + `CreateFlags = 0x08000000` | — | 否：`Create` 返回 21（参数错误） |

所以**不要**设 `CreateFlags`。另外 `Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process` 无法封送内嵌的 `Win32_ProcessStartup` 对象（报「类型不匹配」），必须走经典 `[wmiclass]'Win32_Process'` 路径。`tests/selfcheck.mjs` 与 `tests/host-arm-e2e.ps1` 都固化了这几条，防止回退。

### 6. 停止顺序必须先杀 Electron 主进程，否则每次都闪一个 Windows 对话框

**现象**：一键重启时会短暂闪出一个白色 Windows 对话框，同时响一声系统提示音。用探针（窗口截图 + 读子控件文字 + WASAPI 分进程声音归因）抓到的是：

```
243185 / 243496  taskkill   逐个杀应用进程
243726  NEW-WINDOW  #32770  «DeepSeek Harness 无法使用»
243818  CAPTURE     标题「DeepSeek Harness 无法使用」正文「应用无法启动或已意外停止。」
                    按钮：退出 / 重启 / 禁用第三方插件、备份 profile patch 并重启
243912  SOUND       pid=0（Windows 系统声音会话）peak=0.1372
```

**原因**：Electron 主进程把 Host 当作自己的孩子监视。守护脚本原来按 `Get-Process` 的返回顺序（PID 升序）逐个 `taskkill`，而 **PID 会被回收，Host 完全可能排在主进程前面**。Host 先死、主进程还活着的那个瞬间，主进程就走「desktop host stopped」的错误处理，弹出上面这个原生框并播放系统音；紧接着主进程自己也被下一个 `taskkill` 杀掉，所以用户只看到「一闪」。

这也是它偶发的原因：主进程恰好先被杀的那几次重启，什么都不会出现。

**做法**：用 `Win32_Process` 的 `ParentProcessId` 建父子映射，找出**应用根进程**（其余应用进程的祖先，即 Electron 主进程），**单独**先 `taskkill /F`，再用 `Wait-AppProcessGone` 轮询确认它真的消失，之后才动其余进程。父映射拿不到时退化为「最早启动的那个进程」——主进程永远是应用树里最先创建的。`tray/tray-functions.ps1` 的 `Stop-ProcessTree` 走同一套逻辑（托盘路径同样会踩这个坑）。

> 为什么不直接用 Host 传进来的 `targetPid`：进程检测失败时它可能就是 Host 自己，按它先杀等于把 bug 装回去；用 OS 的父子关系判断是自洽的，两条入口都适用。`tests/supervisor-e2e.ps1`（case 4）与 `tests/tray-selfcheck.ps1` 都用「父进程 + 同镜像名子进程」复现了这个树形并锁住顺序。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 DSH 里（推荐）：plugin_manager install_bundle，target = 本目录绝对路径
# 或走桌面端自带 CLI carrier：
$dsh = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<你克隆这个仓库的路径>"
```

### 唯一一次人工引导（之后不再需要）

安装后：

- **客户端半（按钮）立即生效**：`sidebar.footer.action` 里会出现 `ui-dsh-restart / dsh-restart`（可用 `cordis_inspect_query` 的 Client `Slots` 确认）。
- **Host 半（重启路由）需要一次应用重启才加载**。三条实测结论，都不要再试：
  1. **Host 半不能热重载**。`plugin_manager set_plugin` 能干净地注销/重挂这一行（路由随禁用消失、启用后回来），但进程内的 ESM 模块缓存会一直交出**第一次 import 的那份代码**。实测：改完磁盘上的 `index.js` 后反复「禁用→启用」，报错栈的行号与文件内容始终是旧版本。
  2. **改包版本也无效**。把 `version` 从 1.0.0 提到 1.0.1 再 `install_bundle`，只会得到 `ambiguous-install`；模块缓存按解析出的标识符缓存，与版本无关。
  3. **profile 里的 `dsh-hmr` 只监视 profile 自身**（`baseDir` = profile 目录），不监视被 `link:` 进来的外部插件目录，所以改外部包也不会触发重载。

  因此请**手动关闭并重新打开 DeepSeek Harness 一次**（托盘 → 退出，或关闭窗口后重新打开）。此后每次插件迭代都只需点按钮。

> **一次教训**：Host 半第一次激活失败时，失败会被这一代进程记住（`fiberPhase: failed`），而磁盘上的修复无法生效——缓存里是旧代码。这一轮就是这样暴露并修掉了两个真实缺陷（cordis 在未 `inject` 时访问 `ctx.parent` 会抛错；locale 服务上并没有 `t`，正确用法是 `ctx.locale.bind(ns)`）。**Host 半的改动必须换进程才能验证。**

#### 引导期的安全顺序（重要）

profile patch 在**你自己的用户目录**里（`$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`），不可能随包交付，所以演练守卫需要你手动加一次。第一次安装时，正在运行的 Host 可能早于你最后一份代码；为避免误点造成「应用被关掉却没有重新拉起」，请**先加守卫再重启**：

```yaml
# $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml
- id: dsh-plugin-restart
  disabled: false
  config:
    dryRun: true
```

顺序：

1. 写入 `dryRun: true`，**先重启应用**（配置层是热生效的，守卫在旧代码上同样有效：按钮只会返回计划）。
2. 重启后跑下面的自检，确认 `supervisorScript` 指向本包的 `lib/restart-supervisor.ps1`，且 `supervisorRuntime.source` 是 `windows-powershell`（或你显式设置的 `DSH_POWERSHELL`）。
3. 把 `config: dryRun: true` 整段删掉（或改为 `false`），配置层热生效，**不需要再重启**——此后按钮执行真实一键重启。

### 引导后自检（非破坏性）

```powershell
# 计划与运行时证据（不产生任何副作用）
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-restart/status `
  -ContentType application/json -Body '{}' -Headers @{ Origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:19387' } |
  Select-Object -ExpandProperty value |
  Select-Object supervisorScript, supervisorSource, supervisorCandidates, supervisorRuntime, target

# 演练：只返回计划，绝不重启
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-restart/restart `
  -ContentType application/json -Body '{"dryRun":true}' -Headers @{ Origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:19387' }
```

`supervisorScript` 必须存在且指向本包的 `lib/restart-supervisor.ps1`；`supervisorRuntime.source` 为 `windows-powershell` 表示守护脚本用系统 PowerShell 5.1 启动，设为 `DSH_POWERSHELL` 时表示用了你指定的解释器。

卸载：`& $dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-restart`。

## 使用

1. 重建你的插件（`pnpm build` 等）。
2. 点左下角的「重启 DSH」图标 →「立即重启」。
3. 应用自动退出并回来，页面重连后可继续同一会话。
4. 若没回来：看 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-plugin-restart\restart.log` 与 `restart-result.json`，两者都记录了守护脚本每一步。

## 配置（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-restart
  name: dsh-plugin-restart
  config:
    enabled: true         # 关闭重启路由（返回 409）
    armDelayMs: 1200      # Host 侧：HTTP 应答与守护脚本启动之间的延迟
    graceMs: 2000         # 等待应用自行退出的时间，超时后强杀进程树
    dryRun: true          # 只返回计划、绝不真正重启（排障用）
    relaunch: false       # false = 不 spawn 守护脚本，改为写触发文件交给托盘处理
    trayTriggerPath: ''   # 默认为 <DSH_HOME>/dsh-plugin-restart/restart-request.json
    supervisorPath: ''    # 覆盖守护脚本路径（一般不用）
    loaderPackageDir: ''  # 覆盖模块加载目录，用于从 link: 之外的布局定位本包
```

触发文件只在**守护脚本启动失败**（或 `relaunch: false`）时写出：如果每条请求都写，常驻托盘就成

plugins.description: DSH plugin: pin the no-context fallback Workspace of new Sessions to one fixed folder (browser-side uiWorkspace policy, no host code).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-default-workspace

A small DSH plugin that pins the **no-context fallback Workspace of new
Sessions** to one folder, chosen in the Settings dialog.

## Why this exists

DSH chooses the Workspace of a new Session from context, never from
configuration:

| Situation | Stock DSH behavior | With this plugin |
|---|---|---|
| A Session holding a conversation is open in some folder | the new Session stays in that folder | unchanged |
| The app opens on a saved Session holding a conversation | that Session is restored | unchanged |
| An explicit target is passed (a workspace row's **+**, *add workspace*) | that target is used | unchanged |
| **Nothing to go on**: no saved selection, a saved Session that no longer exists, or a saved/current **empty New Session** (nothing ever sent) | the *most recently active* Workspace | **the folder chosen in Settings** |
| **The Session you are viewing is archived** | the main selection is cleared and the app drops to its *choose a Workspace* hero | **a new Session in that Session's own Workspace**, or the chosen folder when it had no Workspace |

An empty New Session is not "already conversing in another folder": DSH marks a
Session `blank` (`SessionSummary.blank`) until its first turn starts, and that
flag is what decides the last-but-one row above. Clicking a workspace row and
typing still starts the conversation in that folder; the folder only takes over
once there is a conversation in it.

Archiving is the one case where the folder that comes back is *not* the chosen
one: the conversation is gone but the project is not, so archiving a Session in
`D:\CodeProjects\Moltenfrost` leaves you in `Moltenfrost` with a fresh New
Session. A Session that belonged to no Workspace has no folder of its own to
keep, so it falls back to the chosen folder — the same rule as the row above.
Only clearing a main Session is honoured this way; archiving any other row
navigates nothing, exactly as before.

The Host owns no setting for this. The only "default workspace" concept in DSH
(`workspaceRegistry.initializeDefault`, `<Documents>\deepseek-harness\default-workspace`)
is created once on a pristine install and requires an empty Workspace registry
*and* empty Session history, so it cannot be repointed on an installation that
already has Sessions.

## Choosing the folder

Settings carries one page from this plugin, **Default folder**, as its own
navigation tab (`settings.section`, order 30 — after the shipped sections):

- the selector lists every registered Workspace by path, plus **Follow DSH**,
  which switches the plugin off and restores the stock "most recently active
  Workspace" rule;
- **Choose another folder…** opens the same folder chooser the Workspace UI
  uses — the Desktop preload dialog when the shell exposes it, otherwise the
  Host chooser through `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory()`. A folder the Workspace
  registry does not know yet is registered first, exactly like
  **Add workspace…** (`uiWorkspace.workspaces.create({ path })`), so a picked
  folder is immediately usable;
- the choice is stored in the page's localStorage under
  `dsh.default-workspace.settings` and is read at every routing decision, so it
  applies to the next New Session with no reload and no re-apply.

With nothing stored, the compiled-in `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_PATH` still applies, so
an installation that never opens the page behaves exactly as it did before. A
stored folder that is not registered has no effect and the stock rule stays in
charge — this plugin never invents a Workspace.

The preference lives in the browser, not in the Host user-settings document: the
policy this plugin installs is browser-side, and a Host-backed field would make
the host half depend on the framework's schema package, which a plugin mounted
from a bare `file:///…` path cannot resolve. See *Why localStorage* below.

## Files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Package manifest: host half plus the `dsh.client` declaration and `exports["./client"]` the Client module system scans |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half — deliberately empty; the policy and its Settings page are browser-side |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half — wraps `uiWorkspace.startSession`, `uiWorkspace.restoreSelection`, and `uiWorkspace.clearMain`, and contributes the **Default folder** Settings page |
| `test/interception.test.mjs` | Maintenance check: runs the real browser bundle against a fake `uiWorkspace` and asserts every rule above, the Settings page included |
| `test/host-integration.test.mjs` | Maintenance check: asks the running Host whether it composes and serves this plugin's browser half |
| `test/probe-report.mjs` | Reads the decision trace the browser half writes into the page's localStorage |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Release notes |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

The browser half wraps three navigation entry points on the `uiWorkspace`
service instance. The two navigation wrappers delegate to the stock method for
every case they do not own; the third wraps the clear that ends an archive.
Every wrapper swallows its own failures back into the stock flow, so the worst
case is exactly the stock behavior.

### Why localStorage

The Host settings document edits fields a plugin declares with `.volatile()` in
its exported `Config` schema, which comes from `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. A
plugin mounted as a `file:///…` Loader row resolves its own imports relative to
its directory, so that bare specifier is unreachable without shipping a
`node_modules` next to the plugin. The preference is therefore browser-local,
which is also where the policy lives. The cost is that it is per browser origin
and invisible to the Host configuration file; the benefit is a plugin with no
dependencies at all.

## Four constraints this plugin had to learn the hard way

Each one was learned against the live app rather than from documentation; the
traces from `test/probe-report.mjs` are what pinned them down.

1. **Declare no `inject`.** With `inject: ["uiWorkspace"]` the plugin never
   applied at all — no error, no console line, just a page where the policy did
   not exist. The service does not exist yet when the entry is applied
   (the trace shows `apply` → `waiting` → installed 247 ms later), so the
   browser half polls `ctx.get("uiWorkspace")` every 50 ms instead of waiting.
2. **Never read another plugin's services through a context proxy.** The stock
   bootstrap builds its supersession signal with
   `this.ctx.layout.beginNavigation()`; doing that from here throws
   `cannot get property "layout" without inject` — which made the primary path
   fall back to the stock flow. Supersession is now checked against
   `mainReference`, and `test/interception.test.mjs` runs against a service whose
   `ctx` has no `layout` at all, so this cannot regress unnoticed.
3. **`blank`, not "exists", decides.** A saved Session that still exists but
   never received a turn is an empty New Session, and must not pin its folder.
   DSH's `SessionSummary.blank` carries exactly that fact.
4. **The boot watcher is one-shot, and archiving is not a navigation entry
   point.** `uiWorkspace.watchNavigation` restores a selection exactly once, at
   startup; afterwards it only watches for one thing — a main Session that has
   become archived — and its reaction to that is `clearMain()`, which drops the
   main reference *and* the persisted selection and leaves the stock hero
   standing. Wrapping `startSession` and `restoreSelection` therefore misses
   archiving completely, and a page that archives its main Session sits on
   "choose a Workspace" until the user navigates by hand. The trace proves it:
   the two `startSession` decisions that recovered the app are 20 seconds apart,
   with nothing at all recorded in between. `clearMain` is the only choke point
   every archive route passes through — the row action, the shortcut, the
   stop-and-archive dialog, another plugin, and the watcher's own
   `clearArchivedCurrent` — so that is what gets wrapped, and it reads the
   Session's Workspace *before* delegating, because the clear is what erases the
   identity that names it.

## Mounting

The plugin is mounted by one patch in the profi

plugins.readme_text: Web profile plugin — host half + browser half. > **English**: [README.md](README.md) | **中文**: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) --- # DSH Hardware Sandbox **A 3D hardware sandbox for DSH: build the assembly, wire it up, and run your project's own code against virtual hardware.** **Install (from GitHub; this package is not published on npm)** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard ``` Then reload the page. The sandbox registers into the **`main`** slot (the 3D view) and the **`sidebar.panellist`** slot (the panels); `skill/SKILL.md` ships with the plugin, so an agent that has it installed already knows how to drive it. **Like it?** Open this plugin's page in the Plugins manager — its own bottom-right corner carries a small, plain-text link to [give it a star on GitHub](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard). It is one transparent line, no box, no banner, and it only ever appears on this plugin's page. Three things make that one line work — all three are in this repository: | Requirement | Where | Note | |---|---|---| | repo topic `dsh-plugin` | GitHub repository topics | makes the repo discoverable in community lists | | a `dsh.bundle` manifest | `package.json` → `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` | **without it `dsh plugin add` installs nothing** — and the UI symptom is misleading: the plugin list says "no composition bundle declared", while what actually broke is the assembly, so every `/api/*` returns 404 and the panel simply never appears | | an exported `apply(ctx)` | `src/index.ts` (host) / `src/client/index.ts` (browser) | host half registers routes, tools and the simulation engine; browser half registers the two slots above | ## What it is / what it solves Normally the parts of a hardware project you can only *try on the real board* are the wiring itself, the sensor semantics at register level, and the failure handling. This plugin moves those into a virtual scene that actually runs: - **3D assembly** — drop parts from the built-in model library (ESP32, Raspberry Pi 4B, BME280, HC-SR501 PIR, LED module, MPL3115A2, breadboard), wire them port by port, and get a live SSOT (single source of truth) assembly state with topology and electrical checks. - **Project-level hardware-in-the-loop** — a **real Python process** runs **your project's code**. A Python shim intercepts its `smbus`/I2C access and answers from virtual devices, so the project under test reads register-level values (e.g. it performs the real BME280 compensation math on data coming from the virtual chip). - **Networked-device emulation** (a second, separate class of virtual hardware) — a device that actively POSTs to **your** external HTTP backend on a real cadence: register → pull config → periodic report. Verified end-to-end against a real seat-selection system (device → HTTP → backend state machine → database). - **Failure injection** — unplug a wire, return NACK, force a reading, take a device offline, and watch whether the project's error handling actually catches it. - **Project-level convenience** — scan a real project folder to learn which hardware it needs, and switch the entire hardware setup in one click. Requires DSH with the **`web`** profile and `webServer`, `tools` and `subprocess` services. The host half declares them as **hard `inject` dependencies on purpose**: if any of them is missing the plugin does not activate at all, rather than activating with tools silently unregistered, a blank panel, or a simulation engine that cannot spawn. ### See it without a real project `examples/zhizuo-virtual-esp32/` is a standalone script version of the virtual ESP32 seat sensor. `hw_list_projects` lists the built-in demo project (**zhizuo-seat-node**) together with whether it is currently wired end to end; `hw_import_project` puts its parts, wires and network binding in place in one call. ## UI tour The interface is currently **Chinese only** — the labels below are the literal ones on screen. | Panel | What it does | |---|---| | **③ Project (one-click hardware swap)** | the main workflow. Per project body: file count (`N files (M skipped while sampling)` when sampling skipped files), **Scan requirements**, **Delete**; plus **+ Import project body (pick folder)** and **+ Import model bundle (pick folder)** | | **① Add component** | click a model key to drop it into the scene (collapsed by default) | | **② Re-skin models** | search for a model / import a file, and re-skin one of the model keys above; a model key with no geometry renders as a placeholder box (collapsed by default) | | **Statistics** | render statistics (draw calls / triangles / FPS) — pure read, off by default | | **Center 3D view** | placed components with world transforms, **blue cables** between ports, spatial warning boxes drawn on the components that have `warn`/`error` warnings, gizmo/right-click menu (pin, delete), port tooltips | | **Panel overlay input box** | send a message to the current session without leaving the panel; if the host exposes no `agents` service the box is hidden (`capabilities.chat` is absent) | Two of those deserve emphasis: - **Scan requirements is a UI button only.** It is not exposed as an agent tool — the agent side has no equivalent. What the agent *can* do is everything after that: place parts, wire them, build a project blueprint, run simulations. - **Deleting a project only deletes the project definition** (that one JSON). It does **not** touch the scene, so removing a project never wipes the hardware you have on screen. ## Quick start: three steps 1. **Import the project body** — *+ Import project body (pick folder)*, point it at a **complete project folder** (frontend + backend + hardware code). It is imported **without** models; the host reads it to work out which hardware it needs. 2. **Scan what hardware it needs** — the **Scan requirements** button in the ③ panel (UI only, see above). The report lists each candidate model key with the **evidence** — which files it was seen in — so you can judge it yourself; when the scan had to sample, it says so instead of implying it read everything. 3. **Import a model bundle** — *+ Import model bundle (pick folder)*, a folder laid out as `/model.glb`. Whatever you skip keeps rendering as a placeholder box. Or skip steps 1–3 entirely: describe the system to the agent and let it call **`hw_save_project`** to write a blueprint, then **`hw_import_project`** to place every part, wire and network binding in one go. ## Agent tools: 16 `hw_*` tools This is the actual registered list (nothing added, nothing omitted). The **when to use** column is the point of the table: these tools are not interchangeable. ### Projects | Tool | What it does | When to use it | |---|---|---| | `hw_list_projects` | list built-in hardware projects: parts, wires, network config, and whether each is currently wired end to end | **before** hand-placing anything — a blueprint is one call, hand-assembly is four steps and a missed step fails silently | | `hw_import_project` | import a project: **clears the current assembly first**, then places parts, wires and network bindings | switching the whole hardware set; note it *replaces*, it does not add | | `hw_save_project` | create or overwrite a project blueprint (stored under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-hardware-sandbox/projects/`) | the user described a system in words — write it down as a blueprint, then import it | ### Assembly | Tool | What it does | When to use it | |---|---|---| | `hw_get_assembly` | read the SSOT summary: revision, components, connections, warnings (with their `message`, not just the code), power summary, virtual devices | **before every edit** — you need the real port ids; port ids are pin identities (`E4`), not silkscreen names (`GPIO23`) | | `hw_edit_assembly` | one tool over the contract's `ClientAction` union: place / move / rotate / connect / disconnect / remove / pin | any change to the scene. It takes an action object, so read the samples

plugins.readme_text:
# 薇斯纳主题 · 无边框壁纸与底栏优化（0.3.5）

## v0.3.5 更新

- 更换为无边框壁纸，去掉穿过顶部标题的装饰横线。
- 底部状态栏加入与左侧栏一致的模糊背景。
- 统一左栏与底栏的模糊背景，减少接缝色差，保留原生直角。

## v0.3.4 更新

- 修复深色主题下部分下拉列表白底白字、选项看不清的问题。
- 感谢 devil233-ui 提供修复。

## v0.3.3 更新

- 新增聊天框效果切换，可选择液态玻璃或高斯模糊。
- 高斯模糊模式关闭动态高光与边缘折射，降低快速滚动时的渲染开销。
- 自动保存所选效果，重启后无需重新设置。

在「设置 → 薇斯纳主题 → 聊天框效果」切换。高斯模糊使用 3px 静态模糊和细边框；切换时释放液态玻璃引擎。旧设置默认保留液态玻璃。

## v0.3.2 · 2026-10-11

- 优化液态玻璃缓存，减少快速上下滚动时的卡顿。
- 停止按钮改为薇斯纳青绿色，保留原有尺寸，让按钮更醒目。

## v0.3.1 更新

- 修复应用更新后模型回答可能没有玻璃边框。
- 修复 Windows 开启全窗口壁纸时发送／停止按钮悬停闪烁（感谢 devil233-ui 的 PR #1）。

用户消息与模型回答加入透明玻璃外观：薄雾、平滑圆角、方向性边缘反光和轻微背景折射。高光快速跟随鼠标，移出自然归位；回复高度和窗口尺寸变化时自动调整。文字中央不参与边缘折射。保留原有壁纸、六款表情、配色和设置记录。

这是参考苹果设计原则的网页近似效果。支持之前核实的Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2消息结构，以及本次实际安装应用（安装包元数据0.1.7-rc.2）的消息结构。升级应用后可能需要适配。透明内容的可读性受壁纸影响；逻辑配色的对比度测试不代表任意壁纸上都达到4.5:1。

本次已在真实聊天页确认透明背景、平滑曲线和折射图正常加载；未发送模型消息。长对话滚动性能与新请求的完整流式过程仍需实际使用观察。

完整更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 制作的独立主题插件。采用用户认可的双手托脸、微瘦脸、无边框壁纸，以及六款卡通表情。浅色使用奶白遮罩，深色使用海军蓝遮罩；图片不需要联网加载。

## 使用范围

- 设置 → 通用中增加「薇斯纳主题」，提供春日浅色、夜宴深色、跟随系统和默认配色。
- 通过官方 ThemeRuntime 的 token 覆盖接口调整侧栏、阅读区域、输入区域、按钮、菜单、链接、代码块等使用平台配色变量的组件。
- 明暗偏好由 DSH 自己保存；角色配色、壁纸和表情开关单独保存在本机。恢复默认会撤下插件配色和壁纸，隐藏表情。支持读取第一版的保存记录。
- 不接触模型、凭据或聊天文件。不替换程序安装文件。
- 日常表情已接入侧栏「新会话」、主页欢迎区和「发送消息」按钮；文字、快捷键、禁用状态及原有事件处理保留。发送按钮保留小箭头，停止和删除等控件保留原生图标。设置卡片同时提供预览及壁纸/表情独立开关。
- 同一张壁纸铺满整个窗口。左栏、顶部应用控制栏和右侧工具栏采用 12px 高斯模糊及半透明遮罩；输入框、设置卡片和内容工具保持可读背景。遵循系统降低透明度偏好。

## 安装

**最简方法：** 在官方 Desktop「插件 → 添加插件」输入 `dsh-vesna-theme` 安装；可选择中国大陆镜像源或 npm 官方源。新版本在镜像源上可能存在同步延迟。该窗口是官方安装器，不代表插件通过官方市场审核。更新方式请以当前应用提示为准。


已在本机正在运行的 Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2** 中实际安装并启用。已生成 `lib/client.js`，无需自己编译。

1. 从本仓库的 **Releases** 下载 `dsh-vesna-theme-0.3.5.tgz`。
2. 打开 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop → 插件 → 添加插件**，选择下载的安装包。
3. 安装后点击「立即启用」。
4. 到 **设置 → 通用设置 → 薇斯纳主题** 选择配色、壁纸和表情开关。

本机已经完成这些操作，无需重复安装。当前使用夜宴深色，壁纸与表情开启。

本机 Desktop 版本不允许通过 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 管理，安装应走应用插件管理页面。不要用旧版全局 CLI 修改 Desktop 配置。

### 简易安装方法

把下面这段直接发给DSH：

```text
请帮我安装或更新这个DSH Desktop主题插件：https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme
请下载最新Release的tgz安装包，保留现有主题设置，按当前Desktop版本支持的插件安装方式处理；不要使用旧版全局CLI改Desktop配置。
```

具体能否自动安装取决于DSH当前的工具权限；需要手动操作时，按上面的插件页面步骤完成。

## 恢复与卸载

临时恢复：主题设置点「默认配色」。恢复后仍保留当前原生明暗模式。

卸载：先恢复默认，再到 Plugins 禁用或移除 `dsh-vesna-theme`，退出并重新打开 Desktop。本机的角色主题选择记录保留，再次安装会沿用。插件选择与原生明暗模式是分别保存的。

## 已完成的验证

- 核对安装包 0.1.7-rc.2 的主题、设置、浏览器模块、插件包元数据与 bundle patch 接口。
- 13 项逻辑测试：持久化、关闭配色、跨窗口、损坏记录、未来版本记录保护、保存失败、清理、文字对比度、状态颜色保留、装饰开关保存、壁纸配色切换。
- 使用该版本实际的 ThemeRuntime、平台 CSS 和 React，在 Edge 无界面浏览器中验证真实插件设置组件。检查浅色、深色、系统明暗变化、重载保存、跨窗口关闭、360px 宽度、壁纸开关、表情开关、图片解码、插件卸载后的样式和标记清理；未出现浏览器脚本错误。
- 正文、辅助文字、代码与选中按钮文字的测试配色达到 4.5:1 对比度。错误、警告、成功和差异配色保留平台含义。
- 外面的预览 PNG 是组件测试页面，并非 Desktop 实际截图。实际 Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 已通过插件管理页面安装、启用，设置卡片和六表情显示正常；重新打开的窗口保留深色偏好，聊天主页壁纸正常显示。未发送模型请求；长对话和所有其他页面尚未逐页检查。

## 维护

源码在 `src`，预构建文件在 `lib`，无新增 npm 依赖。用户认可的素材位于 `assets`，以无损 WebP 保存，表情保留透明度。构建时内嵌图片，避免额外图片服务和文件路由依赖。

```text
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/controller.test.mjs
```

已通过本机调试接口直接核验 Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 中的样式和操作；不使用 Computer Use。检查全窗口壁纸、左右栏、顶部模糊、侧栏收起/展开、新会话、发送按钮空输入禁用与输入后启用、独立开关、明暗切换和默认恢复；测试草稿清空，没有发送模型请求。长对话运行中的停止按钮尚未执行测试。CSS 依赖核实过的模块角色，应用升级后应重新检查。

这是非官方主题。MIT 许可仅适用于本插件代码，不包含角色名称与角色图像的权利。图片由内置 image_gen 参照用户截图生成，保留的 PNG 原图位于外部「薇斯纳主题素材」目录。

## 最新界面调整（2026-10-08）

- 只有窗口最外层铺壁纸，聊天视口及消息气泡透明，避免重复画面。
- 侧栏、顶部及右栏模糊8px；输入框取消背景模糊，使用更实的底色，修复 Windows 发送／停止按钮悬停闪烁。
- 添加文件/调用指令菜单使用不透明的主题底色，避免聊天正文透入菜单。
- 招呼语为「找我什么事呀，亲爱的朋友~」，与主页输入区靠左；欢迎表情84px。原DS图标及预览标签隐藏。
- 新会话使用36px脸部头像、48px高按钮；发送使用40px脸部与爱心头像、88×46px按钮。通过CSS裁切原画减少身体及留白，头像旁保留文字，没有箭头遮住爱心。两处悬停或键盘聚焦显示80px完整表情，移开、失焦或按键后收起。
- 添加文件保留原生加号；好的回答/有问题的回答保留原生评价图标。悬停或键盘聚焦时，分别显示64px的读书/点赞/疑惑表情。添加菜单打开时隐藏文件入口的表情。
- 六张表情均有日常位置：比耶→新会话；思考→欢迎；读书→文件入口悬停；疑惑→负面评价悬停；点赞→正面评价悬停；爱心→发送。
- 默认配色或关闭表情后恢复原生功能控件；按钮事件和可访问名称保留。

本次在实际Desktop中核验了模糊值、按钮尺寸、原生图标、文件菜单底色及悬停表情，未发送模型请求或提交回答反馈。13项逻辑测试及真实ThemeRuntime组件验证通过。长对话运行中的停止按钮未测试。

独立素材在外部「薇斯纳壁纸和独立表情」目录，包含原壁纸PNG和六张独立透明通道PNG；只裁分原图，没有重新绘制。


## 头像按钮方案验收

在实际应用检查新会话、发送的脸部裁切、完整悬停预览和键盘聚焦；原画文件未修改。页面切换后仍能显示预览，空输入发送保持禁用，无横向溢出。浮层避开按钮、保持在窗口范围内，关闭主题或卸载会移除浮层和事件监听。ThemeRuntime组件验证通过，未发送模型请求或回答反馈。


## 主页输入区自适应修正

主页输入区宽度约为可用内容区的38%，窄屏最小360px并受容器边距限制，使其右缘约停在壁纸人物左侧耳朵位置；编辑区域最小高度随输入区宽度变化，范围52–160px。保持普通窗口和宽屏的视觉比例。

通过已连接实际DSH页面的临时视口尺寸测试：1280、2400、900、700px宽度。更新后普通窗口输入卡片约346×127px，宽屏约771×156px；右缘停在壁纸人物左侧耳朵附近。无横向溢出、发送按钮未越界，聊天页原有输入框样式保持。测试后已撤销视口模拟并恢复原窗口显示。没有发送消息。

## v0.3.1 修复验证

新增构建类名的模型回答、延迟加载消息样式和清理逻辑已做浏览器回归；实际 Desktop 中确认模型回答玻璃边框和输入框无 backdrop-filter，并检查有文字时发送按钮悬停，测试草稿已清空。13 项逻辑测试通过。运行中的停止按钮修复由 PR #1 作者在 Windows 11 实测确认，本机仅验证停止状态样式，没有发起模型请求。


v0.3.2 浏览器对照回归：六条消息往返滚动，预热后重复贴图编码由 48 次降至 0 次。该结果验证减少重复计算，不代表所有设备的帧率保证。停止按钮为 34px 青绿色圆形底座，16px SVG。


v0.3.3 验证：14项逻辑测试通过；真实 React 与 ThemeRuntime 组件验证切换、重载保存、明暗主题及360px窄屏。浏览器回归确认高斯模式无SVG折射滤镜，滚动与鼠标移动不产生贴图编码，切回液态模式只保留一个引擎。尚未取得贡献者电脑的帧率对照结果。


## 社区市场发现与分发

本仓库已添加 `dsh-plugin` GitHub Topic，支持按该 Topic 搜索的社区市场发现。各市场的索引刷新和兼容性筛选不同，添加标签不代表官方认证或已被所有市场收录。

正式安装包在 GitHub Releases；npm 已公开发布，可按包名 `dsh-vesna-theme` 安装。最新 npm 版本请以 registry 查询结果为准。

维护者发布 npm：登录自己的 npm 账号后，在仓库目录执行 `npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org`。发布前会重新构建并运行逻辑测试。


v0.3.5 验证：无框 PNG 到 WebP 为逐像素一致的无损转换；底栏随输入框增高更新边界，卸载清理还原样式。14 项逻辑测试和真实 React/ThemeRuntime 浏览器回归通过。交界保留原生直角，macOS 实机体验仍待用户确认。

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) browser plugin: give your agent hands inside the Chrome you already use — native messaging + CDP, no TCP port, no Connect button, 9 native browser_* tools.
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文 · Development notes

--- **Give your DSH agent hands inside the Chrome you are already using** — your logins, your tabs, your session. Install once, no Connect button, ever. ![the in-page cursor driving a real page](assets/cursor-demo.gif) Every click flies a cursor to the target and labels what it is doing. It renders *inside the page*, so it lands in screenshots too — you and the model look at the same picture. ## ✨ Why another browser bridge? Every existing option makes you click something, every time: | Option | What goes wrong | |---|---| | `chrome-devtools-mcp --autoConnect` | Chrome asks *"Allow remote debugging?"* on **every** connection | | Browser MCP (store extension) | You must click the extension icon → **Connect** on **every** tab | | WebSocket-based bridges | Open a TCP port and trust anything that can reach it | | **dsh-chrome-bridge** | Nothing to click. Nothing listening on a port. | Three things make the difference: - 🔌 **Native messaging, not a port.** The extension talks to a local Node host over Chrome's native messaging pipe; the CLI reaches the host through a `0600` Unix socket guarded by a token. No TCP port to scan, no origin to spoof. - 🎯 **`chrome.debugger`, not injected scripts.** Clicks and keystrokes are dispatched as real CDP `Input.*` events, so they carry a user gesture — popups open, focus works, and sites that reject synthetic events behave normally. Screenshots, network, console and raw CDP come for free. - 👀 **A cursor the human can see.** Every click flies a small in-page cursor to the target, flashes a ripple and shows a label — and because it is rendered inside the page, **it appears in screenshots**. ## 🏗 Architecture ``` DSH's agent (provided by the harness — this repo ships none) ├── browser_* tools (DSH plugin) ─┐ └── cb CLI (shell) ─┤ ▼ Unix socket /tmp/dsh-bridge.sock (0600 + token) ▼ Node native host ←─ native messaging (stdio) ─→ Chrome extension (MV3) │ chrome.debugger ▼ real CDP ``` **This repo ships no agent** — the agent above is DSH's own; we only give it hands. The extension ID is fixed by the public key embedded in `extension/manifest.json`, so it is **identical on every machine** and the native-host registration never needs editing. ## 🚀 Install Requirements: **macOS**, **Google Chrome 116+**, **Node.js 18+**, and `python3` (installer only, to derive the extension ID). ```bash git clone https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge.git cd dsh-chrome-bridge ./install.sh ``` Then the one manual step, once in your life: 1. open `chrome://extensions` 2. enable **Developer mode** (top right) 3. **Load unpacked** → pick `~/dsh-bridge-extension` Verify: ```bash cb status # host pid … | extension connected: ✅ cb tabs ``` ### 🧩 Optional: native DSH tools Without this you drive the bridge from a shell (`cb …`). With it, DSH gets **9 native tools**, and screenshots come back as **images the model actually sees**. Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → paste either of these → Install → Enable → **restart DSH**: ``` /absolute/path/to/dsh-chrome-bridge/plugin # local checkout (recommended for development) github:OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge#path:plugin # straight from GitHub, no clone needed ``` | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `browser_tabs` | list / find / open / close / activate tabs | | `browser_read` | visible text, HTML, attributes, page info | | `browser_click` | click by selector, by text, or by coordinates | | `browser_input` | type, press keys, select, upload, hover, scroll | | `browser_nav` | navigate and wait for load | | `browser_screenshot` | screenshot **returned as an image** (viewport / full / element) | | `browser_eval` | run JS in the page | | `browser_wait` | wait for an element to appear | | `browser_dialog` | release alert / confirm / prompt | > A freshly installed bundle is not hot-loaded; the app must be restarted once. > `dsh plugin add` from the CLI refuses the app-managed profile — use the GUI. > Plugin updates are not automatic in DSH yet: to upgrade, uninstall and install again. > A **local path** install is a `link:`, so a `git pull` is enough there. ## 📖 Usage ### `cb` — from the shell ```bash cb status / cb version / cb reload # health, hot-reload the extension after edits cb tabs # list tabs (* = active) cb find # filter by title/URL cb info active # title, URL, viewport, pending dialog cb text active [selector] # visible text (best first read) cb html active [selector] cb attr active cb wait-for active "" # wait until it exists and is visible cb eval active "" # run JS in the page cb click-el active "" # real mouse event cb click-text active "Sign in" cb click active cb type active "text" --into "" cb key active Enter # combos: "meta+a" cb focus / cb select / cb upload / cb hover / cb scroll cb dialog active accept # release an alert/confirm — otherwise the page hangs cb nav active https://example.com cb shot active --out /tmp/x.png # --full whole page, --sel "" one element cb console active / cb network active --reload cb cursor active click 400 300 # drive the cursor by hand cb cdp active Page.reload '{}' # raw CDP escape hatch ``` `active` can be replaced by a tab id. Add `--json` for raw output. Clicks and typing move the visible cursor by default; pass `--no-cursor` to skip it. ### Management ```bash dsh-chrome-bridge status # repo / installed / running version + connection dsh-chrome-bridge update # sync code + hot-reload the extension (no Chrome clicking) dsh-chrome-bridge test # end-to-end self test dsh-chrome-bridge logs # extension log + host log dsh-chrome-bridge uninstall ``` ## 🔒 Security Be honest about what this is: **the extension can read and control every page you are logged into.** - The bridge is **local-only**. Native messaging is a private pipe; the CLI socket is `0600` and additionally token-guarded. **No network listener is opened.** - Chrome shows a permanent *"… is debugging this browser"* banner while attached. That banner is the point — you can always see that it is active. - Anything that can already run as your user can read your Chrome profile; this does not widen that boundary. It does make it *convenient*, which is worth a thought before leaving an agent unattended. - **Once the DSH plugin is installed, the model drives your browser without asking.** Plugin tools run inside the DSH host process, so they are *not* gated by the workspace sandbox or the approval prompts that guard `bash`. That is

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的开发流程增强插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-process-kit

[![CI](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-process-kit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-process-kit)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-process-kit)](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/LICENSE)

通过工程化提升产出质量的多角色+多Agent并行开发插件

## 简介

为 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 增加一套文件驱动的工程化开发流程。需求包的状态、门禁签署、流程与 bug 记录都写在目标仓库的 `docs/process/**` 里；插件只做读取、渲染、安全追加和脚手架落地，不另外保存状态。

同时内置 8 个角色 subagent，彼此有硬边界：写实现的不写测试，写测试的不做验收。

## 和同类插件的差别

生态里已有 20 多个近亲（4674 条精选清单里逐个粗筛过），最容易混淆的是这三类：

| 你见过的做法 | 它的判据 | 我们的做法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 规格驱动（spec-kit / OpenSpec / BMAD …） | 靠 LLM 自查「规格写完了没」，或明写**不做硬门禁** | 状态机 + **人签 Gate**：阶段推进权在**人手**上，且**从需求到交付的纠偏不可跳过**（实现过程本身不需要人参与） |
| 角色编排（dsh-crew / dsh-swarm / dsh-expert-team …） | 用**代码强制**角色写权（权限矩阵 / 宿主中间件 / preset） | 角色是**提示词层面**的分工（管效率），**交付质量由 Gate 的人裁承担** —— 刻意不做实时拦截，理由见 [DESIGN](./docs/DESIGN.md) |
| 自动质量门（review-gate / lunheng …） | 机器 verdict 直接放行或阻断 | 机器只判**客观可判**的那半（几何 / 台账 / 落点 / 证据完整性），主观的**留给人裁**；机器侧证据进 `📎` 供抽查 |

三条不可替代的东西：**状态入仓**（`docs/process/**` 是唯一真源，[CI 不装插件也能消费](./docs/CONTRACT.md)）、**防篡改 journal**（链式指纹，读取侧重算并如实报红）、**两段式 Gate 摘要**（✅ 完成了什么 / ❓ 还需要裁定什么）。


## 特性

- **文件状态机**：进度存在 `docs/process/**` 的 frontmatter 中。每轮唤醒调用 `process_status` 即可恢复上下文，不依赖聊天记录。
- **Gate 门禁**：只在 Gate0/1/2/4 (需求核对，设计，开发，验收环节) 停下进行确认，每次输出两段式摘要（✅ 已完成 / ❓ 待裁定）。
- **角色分离**：角色技能随插件注册，项目内 `.dsh/skills/**` 的同名技能可覆盖。
- **零依赖**：不导入插件外库，无构建步骤。
- **只增不改**：`process_init` 默认只创建、不覆盖；已有仓库用 `process_init(upgrade: true)` 升级 —— 框架自有文件覆盖前先备份，`PROJECT.md` 与令牌类项目可定制文件永不覆盖、只报告差异。

## 安装

| 方式 | target | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm（推荐） | `dsh-process-kit` | 从官方 npm 仓库安装，升级只需改版本号（**本版本 `0.5.0`**） |
| GitHub | `github:SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit` | 免 npm；锁版本用 `#<tag>` 或 `#<commit>` |
| 本地目录 | 绝对路径，如 `/Users/<you>/dsh-plugins/dsh-process-kit` | 需要改插件源码时用，先 clone 到本地 |

安装后建议重启客户端，一般情况下无需重启

> **装不到最新版？先看这条：不是安装故障。** pnpm（11/12）默认带 24 小时供应链保护 —— `minimumReleaseAge = 1440` 分钟：**发布不满 24 小时的版本，不会被 `^范围` / `latest` 解析选中**，于是刚发的新版看起来「装不上」，实际装到的是上一个版本。三种解法：
>
> - **等**：满 24 小时后自然解析到新版；
> - **钉版本**（立即生效，显式钉版本按设计绕开该策略）：装 `dsh-process-kit@0.4.0` 这样的确切版本；
> - **加排除**：在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里补
>   ```yaml
>   minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
>     - dsh-process-kit@0.4.0
>   ```
>   不建议直接写 `minimumReleaseAge: 0` —— 那等于把这道保护整体关掉。

## 快速开始

```text
1. 安装插件（安装即生效，无需重启）。
2. 告诉ai想做什么，比如想做一个网站，做一个app等等
3. ai自动初始化当前环境(插件需要的记录) `process_init`
4. 开始按照流程进行开发工作
5. 第一个包建议走快速路径试水：需求核对件写 `flow: fast`，人签 Gate0 后直接派 dev + 存量回归；确认这套流程在你的项目里顺手，再上全流程
```

`process_init` 生成的内容：

- `docs/process/` — `README.md`（流程总纲）、`orchestrator.md`（调度手册）、`PROJECT.md`（项目适配）、PRD 与核对件模板、`tools/README.md`
- `scripts/process/` — `journal-append.mjs`、`check-artifact-paths.mjs`、`check-rules.mjs`、`check-ui-geometry.mjs`、`sync-prd-version.mjs`
- `AGENTS.md` — 仅在不存在时创建；已存在则不改写，只输出待合并段落。传 `agents: false` 可跳过。

### 实例项目（独立仓库）

[dsh-process-kit-example](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit-example) —— 在一个**全新空仓库**里，从一句「做一个电商 app」跑到交付的端到端实例：交付成果、流程产物与 journal 证据都留在那个仓库里，不在本仓库内。

跑法与核验收的检查单见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)（含可直接照抄的开跑步骤，以及一段**不装插件**就能复算 journal 链式指纹的核验脚本）。

> 仓库已建，内容由首次端到端验收跑产出。

### 升级已有仓库

```js
process_init({ upgrade: true, dryRun: true })   // 先看会动哪些文件
process_init({ upgrade: true })                 // 再落地
```

| 文件 | 升级行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 框架自有：`README.md`（总纲）、`orchestrator.md`、四份模板、`tools/README.md`、`scripts/process/*.mjs` | 内容有变才覆盖，旧版备份为 `<文件>.bak-<时间戳>` |
| 项目可定制：`PROJECT.md`、`ui/tokens.md`、`ui/recipe.md` | **永不覆盖**，只列入「需人工比对」并给出包内模板路径 |
| 数据：`input/**`、`prd/<ID>*`、`bugs/**`、`reports/**` 等 | 从不触碰 |

`PROJECT.md` 的 `processVersion` 落后时，报告会提示对照包内模板手工合并。

## 工具

| 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `process_status` | 扫描 `docs/process`，返回每个包的状态、Gate 四灯、journal 尾部、未关闭的 bug 与下一步动作 |
| `gate_summary` | 生成指定包的 Gate 两段式摘要骨架，依据自动填充，✅ / ❓ 留空待填 |
| `process_journal` | 安全追加 journal：锁 + 指纹校验 + 原子替换，时间取机器时间 |
| `process_init` | 将流程骨架与脚本初始化到当前仓库：默认只创建不覆盖；`upgrade: true` 升级已有仓库（框架自有文件覆盖前备份，项目文件永不覆盖） |

## 角色

角色由插件自带技能提供，安装即注册，无需配置。技能在所有工作区可用，与仓库是否已初始化流程无关；项目内 `.dsh/skills/**` 的同名技能优先级更高。设置环境变量 `PROCESS_KIT_SKILLS=off` 可关闭。

### 角色清单（8 个）

`0.1.0` 起可用 7 个，`0.2.0` 补上 `ui-designer`，`0.3.0` 给 `ui-designer` 固定工具优先级（PhotoCraft CLI > Adobe Photoshop > 其它）并把几何门禁的空转判据补硬；`0.4.0` 移除流程看板（改为纯服务端 bundle）、流程骨架按「单 session 单包」精简并把 Gate 送审件换成实物、给 `process_init` 加上 `upgrade` 升级路径；`0.5.0` 给三个评审角色写明触发条件（技能描述随之更新）、修正快速路径与 Gate0 的口径矛盾、补上 [docs/ADOPTION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION.md)（角色仍是这 8 个）：

| 角色 | 职责 | 自 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product-manager` | PRD、接口契约、《设计与说明》；UAT 后做验收完备性审核 | `0.1.0` |
| `test-agent` | 按 PRD 出验收测试（红），并独立复跑 verify（裁判运动员分离） | `0.1.0` |
| `dev-agent` | 按 PRD + 契约把测试实现到绿，只改源码、禁改测试 | `0.1.0` |
| `uat-agent` | 真机黑盒验收：只判「用起来对不对得上预期」 | `0.1.0` |
| `code-review-agent` | 源码 diff 的正确性 / 回归 / 边界 / 可维护性评审 | `0.1.0` |
| `security-review-agent` | 源码 diff 的鉴权 / 越权 / 注入 / 密钥 / 敏感数据评审 | `0.1.0` |
| `logic-review-agent` | 规则表与源码的对抗式逻辑评审：规则→分支映射、未覆盖分支、具体反例 | `0.1.0` |
| `ui-designer` | 把《设计与说明》里触及 UI 的条目翻译成**可验收的 UI 规格**（组件判定 `reuse`/`change`/`new` + 交互状态矩阵 + 用户可见文案定稿），并产出**原型位图**与几何。是否派单由人在 Gate0 用需求核对件的 `uiDesign: required / not-needed` 显式决定，纯后端包流程不变；产物随 Gate1 一并送审，不新增停点 | `0.2.0` |

**`ui-designer` 的边界**（四条，都是实测出来的）：

- **只翻译不发明**。上游没写的一律不拍板，产出「未定口径」清单交人裁。实测给一个只有原始需求、没有 PRD 的包，它交回 8 条未定口径、并明确说明"没加某状态是为了避免发明"。
- **项目令牌优先**。`PROJECT.md` §4 配了「UI 项目令牌」就**必须照抄**项目自己的设计规范，不得自创配色/字号/间距，也不得混用通用默认。门禁 **⑩** 会抽出色板来验。
- **审美留给 Gate**。门禁只判**客观可判**的那部分（几何 + 渲染对比度 + 令牌一致性），好不好看一律交人。
- **工具优先级固定：PhotoCraft CLI > Adobe Photoshop > 其它**。首选 PhotoCraft 是因为「出图」与「导几何」同源于一份 `.psd`，命令可复现、`--verify` 走得通；**Photoshop 是真人设计师的交付路径**（原生 `.psd` 分层源直接可用），几何那一环自己接 —— 读不动时手工导出的证据**必须标注「未经重导验证」**，不许冒充门禁验证过。工具仍不绑定，三条不使用路径照旧合法。

### 三个评审角色什么时候会跑到

8 个角色**不是平权的**，分两档：

| 档 | 角色 | 什么时候被派 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **单包流程**（每个包都走） | `product-manager` · `ui-designer`（`uiDesign: required` 时）· `test-agent` · `dev-agent` · `uat-agent` | 包从 Gate0 走到 Gate4 的过程中按状态机派 |
| **发布回归**（默认不在单包出现） | `code-review-agent` · `security-review-agent` · `logic-review-agent` | **只在「发布前整体回归」被派**，而该环节由人显式发起 |

也就是说：**没发起过发布回归，就等于这三个角色一次都没跑过。** 实测四个自用仓库的 **3 份**可读 journal（另有 1 份只剩 `.bak`，见 [ADOPTION](./docs/ADOPTION.md) §6）+ 实例端到端那一次的 **2 份**，全文扫描：这三个角色**零命中、零份报告** —— 不是它们没用，是**触发权在人手上**，而发布回归一直没被发起过。

两个例外会让它们提前上场：① 人在任一 Gate 上点名；② 包触及 RBAC / 金额·分摊 / schema / 新增对外接口，主控会在 Gate 摘要里给出「是否提前跑评审」这一条。

`process_status` 在仓库里有包 `done` 时会**如实报** `docs/process/reports/release/**` 有没有报告 —— **没有就是没跑**，不得当已覆盖。

## 配置

需要配置的只有 `docs/process/PROJECT.md`。流程文档不硬编码任何具体项目的路径与命令，全部引用该文件，因此插件升级不会覆盖已填写的内容，切换项目也只需重填此文件。

七个小节：§1 端与目录、§2 命令槽、§3 产物属主表、§4 项目配置、§5 UAT 前置自检、§6 环境与凭据、§7 通知（已废弃，编号占位）。

**最小可用只填三节**：§1 + §2（至少「快速验证」与「journal 追加」两行）+ §3。§4 每个键都有默认值、可先用着；§5 / §6 等到要跑 UAT 再填；§7 整节写「不适用」。**§3 是硬门槛**：不填会让落点门禁直接 `exit 1`（刻意不静默放行），不属于"以后再配也行"的那类可选项。

模板中所有 `<...>` 均为占位符，会被脚本忽略，不会成为有效配置。详见 [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md)。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md) | PROJECT.md 七个小节、占位符规则、门禁脚本 |
| [docs/CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONTRACT.md) | 机器可消费契约：frontmatter / journal / 链式指纹算法 / 退出码，**CI 不装插件即可消费** |
| [docs/DESIGN.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md) | 设计红线、四处必须同步的改动、已知陷阱 |
| [docs/ECOSYSTEM.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ECOSYSTEM.md) | DSH 插件生态的准入门槛、上架清单与现状 |
| [docs/ADOPTION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION.md) | 落地实测：四个自用仓库走到哪一步、一个包的全流程时间线与 Gate 间隔耗时、真实返工、AI 托管对照（17.9h vs 2.01h）、装置缺陷与四个可数指标 |
| [docs/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md) | 插件验收：在全新项目里跑通一个电商 app 的端到端场景、AI 托管 Gate、可机器核验的检查单 |
| [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-pr
